title: CREATE A BLANK VOLUME FILE
description: Creates a volume file full of zeros.  Exactly one of -plumb or -sform must be specified.

axis_order.description: a string like 'XYZ' that specifies which index is along which spatial dimension

x_spacing.description: change in x-coordinate from incrementing the relevant index

y_spacing.description: change in y-coordinate from incrementing the relevant index

z_spacing.description: change in z-coordinate from incrementing the relevant index

x_offset.description: the x-coordinate of the center of the first voxel

y_offset.description: the y-coordinate of the center of the first voxel

z_offset.description: the z-coordinate of the center of the first voxel

plumb.description: set via axis order and spacing/offset

xi_spacing.description: increase in x coordinate from incrementing the i index

xj_spacing.description: increase in x coordinate from incrementing the j index

xk_spacing.description: increase in x coordinate from incrementing the k index

yi_spacing.description: increase in y coordinate from incrementing the i index

yj_spacing.description: increase in y coordinate from incrementing the j index

yk_spacing.description: increase in y coordinate from incrementing the k index

zi_spacing.description: increase in z coordinate from incrementing the i index

zj_spacing.description: increase in z coordinate from incrementing the j index

zk_spacing.description: increase in z coordinate from incrementing the k index
